verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is a tax calculation and compliance API/service, not an agent or AI assistant that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The official Stripe MCP server (probe-4) is the server role, which belongs to a separate story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
